cues.en: Instructor: Now I'm going to show you how to create histograms with different numbers of bins according to, in particular, the Freedman-Diaconis rule,
cues.zh: 現在展示不同區間數的直方圖，特別依Freedman–Diaconis規則，

cues.en: which, as I mentioned in the previous video, is generally probably the best way to pick the number of bins for a histogram.
cues.zh: 如前一部所說，大概是挑區間數最好的方法。

cues.en: It's certainly the most commonly used method.
cues.zh: 肯定最常用。

cues.en: Okay, so let's get started by creating some data.
cues.zh: 先建立資料。

cues.en: These are log-normal data, so we take normally distributed random numbers and push them through this natural exponential function.
cues.zh: 是對數常態，把常態隨機數送進自然指數。

cues.en: Okay, and then, so for starters, I'm just gonna specify that there's going to be k equals 40 histogram bins.
cues.zh: 先指定K=40個區間。

cues.en: So nothing new or particularly earth-shatteringly interesting here.
cues.zh: 沒什麼新或驚人的內容。

cues.en: This is just a kind of, you know, this is like a gentle reminder of where we're going here, and where we're going is basically applying some algorithm
cues.zh: 只是溫和提醒方向，接著要套用演算法，

cues.en: to define this k rather than an arbitrary number.
cues.zh: 定義K，而非任意挑數。

cues.en: Okay, so here is the code implementation of the Freedman-Diaconis algorithm that I explained in the previous video.
cues.zh: 這是前一部解釋的Freedman–Diaconis演算法實作。

cues.en: So we have the IQR, the inner quartile range, divided by the cube root of n.
cues.zh: IQR，四分位距，除以N的立方根。

cues.en: Now, you don't see any division here, but actually I have a minus sign inside the exponent, so that does the same thing as saying
cues.zh: 沒看到除法，但指數裡有負號，等同，

cues.en: n to the power of one third and then put that in the denominator.
cues.zh: N的三分之一次方放分母。

cues.en: And then here, so remember from the previous video that the Freedman-Diaconis rule actually doesn't directly tell us how many bins to use.
cues.zh: 記得，FD規則不直接告訴我們區間數。

cues.en: Instead it tells us how many, or sorry, it tells us the width of each bin, and then we apply that other formula that I showed you in the slide
cues.zh: 而是區間寬度，再用投影片另一個公式，

cues.en: and that converts the bin width into a number of bins.
cues.zh: 把寬度轉成數量。

cues.en: So let's see what that number of bins is here.
cues.zh: 看看這裡有多少區間。

cues.en: So here I'm calling this parameter b, and I don't know why I call it b here.
cues.zh: 把參數叫b，不知道為什麼。

cues.en: I called it k in the slides and I call it k up here.
cues.zh: 投影片與上面叫K。

cues.en: Maybe I just called it b so that it's separate from k.
cues.zh: 可能想和K區分。

cues.en: Anyway, it's pretty interesting to see that the Freedman-Diaconis rule suggests that we use 39 bins here, whereas I more or less arbitrarily said 40 bins.
cues.zh: 有趣的是，FD建議39個，我任意說40。

cues.en: So we can see that 40 was already a pretty decent guess.
cues.zh: 所以40已經是不錯的猜測。

cues.en: So then we can make a histogram.
cues.zh: 接著畫直方圖。

cues.en: This won't really look a whole lot different because the number of bins is the same.
cues.zh: 差異不大，因為區間數相近。

cues.en: Now, as I mentioned a bunch of times before in this course, I like showing the kind of manual mechanics of these statistical operations in code
cues.zh: 如課程多次說過，喜歡展示統計操作的程式機制，

cues.en: because I think that helps you connect the theory and the formulas and the code and the intuition.
cues.zh: 能幫助連結理論、公式、程式與直覺。

cues.en: But in practice, it's much easier just to use the MATLAB tools or Python tools to do this stuff automatically.
cues.zh: 但實務上，用MATLAB或Python工具自動做，容易得多。

cues.en: So in fact, we can just write histogram and then the data.
cues.zh: 其實只要寫histogram，再給資料。

cues.en: This is the same so far.
cues.zh: 到目前相同。

cues.en: And now here I'm providing an optional input for the bin method to be fd or Freedman-Diaconis.
cues.zh: 加入選用輸入，BinMethod設fd，代表Freedman–Diaconis。

cues.en: Now, how do I know that that's the right thing to do?
cues.zh: 怎麼知道這才對？

cues.en: You know, I wasn't born knowing that this is the right code for a histogram.
cues.zh: 不是天生就知道直方圖該寫這段。

cues.en: So you can type help histogram, and that's going to give you all this information about the histogram.
cues.zh: 可以輸入help histogram，得到所有資訊。

cues.en: I actually prefer to read these help docs directly in the editor window.
cues.zh: 其實比較喜歡直接在編輯器讀文件。

cues.en: So I will typically select this function and click on open histogram, and that opens up the histogram file.
cues.zh: 通常選取函式，按Open histogram，開啟檔案。

cues.en: You can see it's a rather long file.
cues.zh: 可以看到，相當長。

cues.en: This is the function file that generates the histogram.
cues.zh: 這是產生直方圖的函式檔。

cues.en: But importantly, the top of all the function files contains a lot of comments and those comments are exactly what you get when you type help and then the name of the function file.
cues.zh: 重要的是，函式檔開頭有很多註解，就是輸入help加函式名，會得到的內容。

cues.en: I just find this to be a little more convenient because it's a little bit easier to scroll, to go back and forth.
cues.zh: 我覺得較方便，較容易捲動、來回看。

cues.en: You don't have to worry about, you know, if you clear the command window, then the help text is all gone, but it's still here.
cues.zh: 不必擔心清除命令視窗後，說明文字消失，因為仍在這裡。

cues.en: Anyway, doesn't matter.
cues.zh: 總之，不重要。

cues.en: So these are just a list of all the inputs that you can give into it, including the normalization.
cues.zh: 這是所有可提供輸入的清單，包括正規化。

cues.en: So you can normalize according to probability, for example.
cues.zh: 例如依機率正規化。

cues.en: Okay, so that's about applying the, let's see, you can generate this again.
cues.zh: 這就是套用，看看，再產生一次。

cues.en: So that's about applying the Freedman-Diaconis rule.
cues.zh: 就是套用Freedman–Diaconis規則。

cues.en: What I want to do now is just, you know, in this final bit of code here, basically just going in a loop through different numbers of bins for the histogram.
cues.zh: 最後這段程式，走訪不同直方圖區間數。

cues.en: So we're going to loop through lots of histograms with bins from going up to 500 and starting at five.
cues.zh: 從5開始，一直到500。

cues.en: Now, we know that the Freedman-Diaconis rule recommends 39, which is also happens to be in here.
cues.zh: 知道FD建議39，剛好也在這裡。

cues.en: Okay, so basically we're just going to loop through all of these bins, recreate the histogram using a plot, so histcounts, and then getting the the bin centers from the bin edges,
cues.zh: 基本上走訪各個數量，用histcounts重新建立直方圖，再由邊界得到中心，

cues.en: updating the plot and updating the title and pausing for half second.
cues.zh: 更新圖、標題，暫停半秒。

cues.en: I think in the interest of time, I'll turn this down to .2.
cues.zh: 為了時間，改成0.2。

cues.en: Okay, so this just creates a movie, and you can see what effect the number of bins has on the resulting plot.
cues.zh: 產生動畫，看看區間數對結果圖形的影響。

cues.en: So it's actually pretty interesting.
cues.zh: 很有意思。

cues.en: I think I'll run through that movie again 'cause it's fun to watch.
cues.zh: 再播一次，因為很好看。

cues.en: So you can see that the overall shape of this distribution is basically the same.
cues.zh: 整體分布形狀基本相同。

cues.en: You know, we still see this high concentration here and some outliers out here, but it's pretty clear that too few bins, remember, the first thing with five bins,
cues.zh: 這裡仍很密，外面有些離群值，但很明顯，太少區間，記得最初五個時，

cues.en: that was basically just going down.
cues.zh: 基本上一路下降。

cues.en: You didn't see this decrease over here.
cues.zh: 看不到這裡的減少。

cues.en: So too few bins is not really appropriate, too many bins is not appropriate, and somewhere in the middle generally looks good.
cues.zh: 太少、太多都不適合，中間某個數量通常不錯。

cues.en: And for this dataset, that happens to be somewhere around 40 bins.
cues.zh: 這個資料集，剛好大約40。

cues.en: All right, so the idea here is that I'm gonna create a dataset, nothing particularly remarkable, just a log normal dataset.
cues.zh: 先建立資料集，沒特別之處，只是對數常態。

cues.en: So we take randomly distributed numbers and pass them through the natural exponential.
cues.zh: 取隨機數，送進自然指數。

cues.en: And then here I'm showing a histogram with the number of bins set to be 40.
cues.zh: 畫40個區間的直方圖。

cues.en: And, you know, that's just a kind of arbitrary-ish number.
cues.zh: 只是有點任意的數。

cues.en: I did poke around a little bit and decided that 40 was a reasonable number of histograms just based on visual inspection.
cues.zh: 我稍微試過，視覺判斷40是合理的直方圖區間數。

cues.en: Okay, so this is nothing new, nothing particularly interesting yet.
cues.zh: 到這裡沒有新或特別有趣的。

cues.en: The new stuff comes here when we implement the Freedman-Diaconis rule.
cues.zh: 新的部分，是實作Freedman–Diaconis規則。

cues.en: So you'll remember from the slides from the previous video that the formula for the Freedman-Diaconis rule actually doesn't tell us directly the number of bins that we need.
cues.zh: 記得前一部投影片，公式不直接告訴我們需要幾個區間。

cues.en: Instead it tells us the width of the bins, and from the width of the bins, that's what this computes We can apply another formula that I showed in the previous video
cues.zh: 而是寬度，這裡算出寬度後，再套前一部的另一個公式，

cues.en: to convert from bin width into bin number.
cues.zh: 轉成區間數。

cues.en: So here we see we take the inner quartile range, and then in the slides I actually showed it was divided by the cube root of n.
cues.zh: 取四分位距，投影片裡是除以N立方根。

cues.en: Here it looks like I'm multiplying by the cube root of n.
cues.zh: 這裡看起來像乘N立方根。

cues.en: However, notice that I have this minus sign inside the exponent here, and remember from the video about exponents in the section on math prerequisites
cues.zh: 但注意指數有負號，記得數學先備的指數影片，

cues.en: that when you put a minus sign into the exponent, that basically reciprocates the number.
cues.zh: 指數有負號，基本上就是取倒數。

cues.en: So saying times n to the power of minus one third is the same thing as dividing by n to the power of one third.
cues.zh: 所以乘N的−1/3次方，等同除N的1/3次方。

cues.en: Okay, so this gives us the bin width, and then here we compute the number of bins, which up here I called k, and also in the formulas in the previous video, I call it k,
cues.zh: 得到寬度後，這裡算數量，上面與前一部公式都叫K，

cues.en: but here I call it b for some particular reason.
cues.zh: 這裡卻不知為何叫b。

cues.en: Okay, and then we create a histogram with b bins.
cues.zh: 接著畫b個區間的直方圖。

cues.en: And now, actually, I wanna print this out, as well.
cues.zh: 也想列印。

cues.en: So let's print out b.
cues.zh: 列印b。

cues.en: And interesting to note that the Freedman-Diaconis rule in this particular case with these data suggested that we use 28 bins.
cues.zh: 有趣的是，這組資料，FD建議28個。

cues.en: So it's actually a bit fewer than the 40 bins that I kind of arbitrarily selected up here.
cues.zh: 比任意選的40少一點。

cues.en: Now, that number also depends on, you know, the distribution of the data.
cues.zh: 這個數也取決於資料分布。

cues.en: So we can run this again, and I run this cell again just to create a new data set.
cues.zh: 再執行，重新建立資料集。

cues.en: Of course, this is still 40 here because I hard code this, and now it's 28.
cues.zh: 這裡仍是40，因為寫死，現在這裡是28。

cues.en: Let's see what it is when I run this again.
cues.zh: 再執行看看。

cues.en: Wow, so now it's 36.
cues.zh: 哇，現在36。

cues.en: Quite a difference.
cues.zh: 差不少。

cues.en: We get quite a different number of bins using the Freedman-Diaconis rule just by regenerating the data.
cues.zh: 只重新產生資料，FD給的區間數就很不同。

cues.en: And again, that happens because the number of bins is based on the bin width, which is based on the n, which doesn't change, of course, but also on the inner quartile range,
cues.zh: 因為區間數依賴寬度，寬度依賴N，N當然沒改，但也依賴四分位距，

cues.en: which changes every single time I regenerate these random data.
cues.zh: 每次重新產生隨機資料，它都改變。

cues.en: Okay, and then the last thing I want to, oh, there's two more things I wanted to show here.
cues.zh: 最後，喔，其實還有兩件事。

cues.en: One is just to show you that you can also generate these histogram plots, they're called distribution plots, in Seaborn, and it's essentially, you know,
cues.zh: 一個是也能用Seaborn產生這些圖，叫分布圖，基本上，

cues.en: it's not really anything different.
cues.zh: 沒有真正不同。

cues.en: It just has some different visualization defaults so it looks a little bit nicer.
cues.zh: 只是視覺預設不同，看起來較漂亮。

cues.en: So we have the bars here are semi-translucent and we have a line that's plotted on top which estimates the probability density
cues.zh: 長條半透明，上面有一條線，估計機率密度，

cues.en: based on the histogram values.
cues.zh: 依據直方圖數值。

cues.en: Okay, so that's just a little FYI.
cues.zh: 只是告訴你。

cues.en: I now realize there was something up here I forgot to mention.
cues.zh: 現在想起，上面忘記提一點。

cues.en: So we computed the Freedman-Diaconis rule by hand, quote-unquote, well, in code.
cues.zh: 剛才「手動」，其實是用程式，算FD規則。

cues.en: But in practice, you know, you don't really need to write out all this code all the time.
cues.zh: 但實務上不需要每次寫全部。

cues.en: You can actually just use the optional input in Python for the histogram function to say the number of bins equals fd for Freedman-Diaconis,
cues.zh: Python的直方圖函式，可以把bins選用輸入設成'fd'，代表Freedman–Diaconis，

cues.en: and then you don't have to worry about all of this stuff.
cues.zh: 就不用管其他程式。

cues.en: Okay, and then, so Seaborn actually uses the Freedman-Diaconis rule by default.
cues.zh: Seaborn預設其實用FD。

cues.en: So to apply the Freedman-Diaconis rule, you don't have to do anything.
cues.zh: 所以套FD什麼都不必做。

cues.en: You just call distplot.
cues.zh: 直接呼叫distplot。

cues.en: Okay, then the last thing I wanna do is illustrate to you lots of histograms with increasing number of bins.
cues.zh: 最後展示，區間數遞增的大量直方圖。

cues.en: So what I'm doing here is specifying a number of bins that's gonna go from five to n over two where n is total number of data points,
cues.zh: 指定從5到N/2，N是總資料點數，

cues.en: which is 1,000 in this case, and 30 different bins between these ranges.
cues.zh: 這裡1000，在範圍內取三十個不同區間數。

cues.en: And essentially what I'm doing inside this for loop is just creating the histogram data and plotting them as a line.
cues.zh: for迴圈裡建立直方圖資料，再畫線。

cues.en: This is just to give you a sense of how different the histograms can look for different numbers of bins.
cues.zh: 讓你了解，區間數不同，外觀差多少。

cues.en: So here you see this really large prominent blue line here.
cues.zh: 這條突出的藍線非常大。

cues.en: This is from five bins, the lowest number of bins.
cues.zh: 來自五個區間，最少的數。

cues.en: And the bin sizes are so wide that the counts end up being really large.
cues.zh: 區間很寬，次數就很大。

cues.en: That's why this is so prominent.
cues.zh: 所以這麼突出。

cues.en: We have 600 points, you know, more than half of the points in the dataset are in this one bin.
cues.zh: 一個區間有600點，超過資料一半。

cues.en: And then as we get to more and more bins, the counts per bin get smaller and smaller.
cues.zh: 區間越多，每個次數越小。

cues.en: So it's just to give you a little bit of a sense of the effect of changing the bin size.
cues.zh: 這只是展示改變區間大小的效果。

cues.en: Now, if you wanna focus more on the shape rather than just on how they look in absolute terms, we could also modify this code a bit,
cues.zh: 如果想更關注形狀，而非絕對值外觀，也能改一下程式，

cues.en: could say y equals y divided by the maximum value of y, and that's just gonna force all of these largest values,
cues.zh: 令y等於y除以y最大值，強迫所有最大值，

cues.en: all these peaks to be one, and that will let us look at the shape more.
cues.zh: 所有峰，都等於1，方便看形狀。

cues.en: So now, it's pretty interesting to see that, although the distributions do look a bit different for the different number of bins, the overall shape of the distribution
cues.zh: 有趣的是，區間數不同，分布外觀雖略不同，但整體形狀，

cues.en: is pretty well preserved for most cases, except for this blue case where, well, you don't see it now, but where we didn't see anything going down.
cues.zh: 多數情況保留良好，除了藍色，現在看不見，但當時看不到下降的部分。

cues.en: So we couldn't actually see with five bins that there was a sparse clustering of data here as we get towards zero.
cues.zh: 所以五個區間，看不出接近0時，這裡資料聚集較稀疏。
